cases.title: Support agent with receipts

charges: Agent demo gap: no tool logs, task completion rate, or failure mode disclosed.
fixes: Replace "agent" with a concrete action, user, and before/after result.
Attach one receipt: screenshot, benchmark, customer quote, log, or demo recording.
Show the agent's tools, permissions, success criteria, and what happens when it fails.
Operator note: split claim, proof, and ask into three short blocks before posting.
Founder-friendly sentence: the idea may be real, but the public claim needs receipts.

cases.text: The support agent completed 312 refund triage tasks last week. It resolved 68% without escalation, flagged 19 policy conflicts, and posts every tool call plus failure reason into the audit log.

cases.title: AI-native revenue copilot

charges: Buzzword possession: agentic, ai-native, unlock, seamless, 10x, copilot.
Thin receipts: some signal, but not enough to survive a skeptical group chat.
fixes: Replace "agentic" with a concrete action, user, and before/after result.
Add two numbers: time saved, cost reduced, users served, revenue, or eval score.
Attach one receipt: screenshot, benchmark, customer quote, log, or demo recording.
Operator note: split claim, proof, and ask into three short blocks before posting.

cases.text: Our AI-native copilot unlocks agentic productivity for modern revenue teams. It transforms every workflow with seamless intelligence and gives leaders a 10x operating system for growth.
